question: In MS Office 365, the Page Setup dialog box can be found under which of the following tabs?
solution:
The correct answer is **Layout **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Layout:

 
• This is the correct tab for accessing the Page Setup dialog box.
 
• It includes options to set margins, orientation, size, columns, spacing, breaks, line numbers, and hyphenation, among other layout-related settings.

Home:

 
• This tab includes basic formatting options such as font style, size, color, paragraph alignment, and other text formatting tools.
 
• It's primarily used for editing and styling the content of the document.

Draw:

 
• This tab is available in newer versions of Office and is used for drawing, annotating, and handwriting within the document, utilizing various pens and drawing tools.

Insert:

 
• This tab allows you to add various elements to your document such as tables, pictures, charts, links, headers, footers, text boxes, and other media files.
